name: 深度发现有界综合上下文
purpose: Build a deterministic bounded synthesis packet that preserves the roles of supporting, counter, alternative, discriminating, and robustness evidence for adopted findings.
eligibility_checks: at least one anchor finding fits the budget
assumptions: only adopted findings and their verified evidence roles enter the synthesis context
human_gates: preserve unresolved alternatives and evidence boundaries in final prose
diagnostics: used and omitted findings, evidence-card counts, character budget, and omission reasons
allowed_claims: which adopted findings and evidence cards were admitted to synthesis
forbidden_claims: synthesis may strengthen confidence or claim level
